about_the_game:
Mutatns is Hero Shooter PvP/E based battle royale and team based super hero game. With distinctive powers and strategies all alongside weapons and loot with time based shrinking zone all to thrive the battlefield

In a world where memories manifest as physical landscapes, warriors from lost civilizations awaken in a dreamlike arena. The battle isn't just about survival—it’s about reclaiming fragments of a forgotten past. Each player wields a unique ability based on their subconscious fears and desires, changing the world into better place.

Choose your Mutant (Hero) with vast and distinctive super powers starting from AM (Anti Matter), Devastator, Electro, Fey, Hammer Head, Invisible, MJ, Lightspeed, Rings of Fire, Sandy, Sparrow, Striker, Shield, Witch, Ultra Man 

Super, Fast and fun game dynamics

With fast paced gameplay in battle royale or team based make your powers beyond extinct with additional fire arms as secondary weapon across battlefields with two battle royale maps Lycro Lands, Iso Lands and one for TDM at launch


Mutants super powered with no limits

Invisible : A phantom of misdirection, whose invisibility and decoys shatter enemy formations
Devastator : A walking inferno of pure rage, capable of turning the battlefield to ash
Fey : A guardian of nature whose beautiful flora conceals a deadly, poisonous arsenal.
MJ : A mythic warrior who channels god-like power, but only while wielding his mighty hammer, Mjölnir
Lightspeed : A living comet who moves faster than sight, running circles around her enemies to deliver a thousand strikes in a second.

And there are Eighteen Mutants at launch each with unique powers

Launch is only the beginning. I am committed to an ever-evolving universe. Post-launch plan includes a continuous stream of new content:

  • New Mutants: Constantly introducing new powers and strategies.

  • New Battlegrounds: Expanding the multiverse with breathtaking maps that offer new tactical challenges.

  • New Game Modes: Keeping the gameplay fresh and exciting for our dedicated community.
